dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any tips for maintaining a healthy throat?

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Exercise more! The trick is to stay healthy.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: You heard that right. The only way to keep your spirits up so you can speak confidently is by staying healthy.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Projecting your voice so that everyone hears it when you're up in a hot air balloon isn't easy, especially when you're competing against the roar of the crowd and the contestants' impassioned cries.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: I get through so much water over the course of a competition that I could even drink the People of the Springs dry!

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Oh, and speaking of which, if you want to keep your throat in top shape, you should drink more water and less unhealthy beverages!
